note: Product-level metadata only. No files are downloaded in this session; real downloads happen later on the owner's Mac via `make ingest DATASET=<code> CONFIRM=1` (dry run by default). Copernicus GLO-30's EPSG:4326 is stated directly on the product page, so DS-01 is 'verified'. Hardening correction F-08/7.2: source_url is the catalogue/product-description page only; download_url is the verified direct file URL and is NULL for every product here, since none has been confirmed against the provider's real file/tile index -- `make ingest ... CONFIRM=1` refuses to download without one.
